recount-2024: Minnehaha County recount of State Representative District 15 ('Minnehaha Recount' on the 2024 Election History page)
state-canvass: South Dakota State Board of Canvassers: 2024 General Election Canvass and Certificate

notes: Replaces the State Canvass's figures for State Representative District 15; read by eye from the scan (page 1, the typed table headed 'State Representative - RECOUNT District 15' (eleven precinct rows, which add up to its Total row); page 2, the recount board's signed certificate, whose recount column has the same totals and whose official-canvass column has the State Canvass's) and typed into this loader. The State Board of Canvassers' recount certificate (a separate file, the certificate page only) certifies the recount; Minnehaha County's recount board printed these figures.

The certified record, one table a contest with a row for each county and a Total row, linked from the Secretary of State's 2024 Election History page. Page 1 is the signed certificate (a scan); the tables are real text. Every table stored here was read only because each of its columns adds up to its Total row.
